maintained_under: Maintained as part of the specification corpus release process and published via the spec/ tag line, which never shares a tag with engine artifacts (ADR-024 §3.5). The matrix consumes and records the version-line declaration (version-line.md, TS-013-05-01); it updates only when a contract major is introduced or superseded under the bounds of ADR-024 §3.4 (at most two concurrently supported contract majors; one-generation deprecation window).
